notes.title: Final Chapters Update
notes.content:
March 30, 2020 Sword Mans version 1.4.

The story of Sword Mans is complete!

It’s been a long time since I’ve done any updates at all, so I want to make sure this update is a big one. The campaign has finally been finished with the last three chapters! The length of the campaign has doubled in a single update!

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error where the co-op campaign text would sometimes be cut off in some resolutions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the next campaign level would sometimes not unlock.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused a boss to fire too many fireballs.
[*] Fixed a bug where the bosses' health in arena mode would be more than the value on the healthbar (you're welcome).
[/list]

[h1]General Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted some sound balancing for some sound effects. Most notably fire and explosion sounds.
[*] Added unique boss images to each of the bosses healthbars.
[*] Added new bosses to the arena. Some are harder, good luck!
[*] Raised the ceiling height for all arena maps.
[/list]

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New campaign chapter: Chapter 4!
[*] New campaign chapter: Chapter 5!
[*] New campaign chapter: Chapter 6!
[*] Each chapter of the campaign is unlocked once you beat the previous chapter. 
[*] New versus mode: Combined. Before you could play sword mans or gun mans, now you can play both at the same time! Look for the setting in the versus options page.
[/list]

With these three chapters, the campaign has finally been completed. Today marks 2 years since Sword Mans was released, so it's been a long time coming. Sadly, this is also the last big content update I have planned. If you find bugs or have suggestions, feel free to reach out to me at bypassgamestudios@gmail.com or using the steam community hub.

I have other games planned, so if you're interested follow @bypass_games on twitter or keep your eyes peeled for other updates on steam.

I hope you enjoy Sword Mans in its final form, I know I had a blast making it! Thanks!

notes.title: Update: Unity 2019
notes.content:
May 31, 2019 Sword Mans version 1.3.2

The biggest change in this update was an upgrade to Unity 2019. There were a number of bugs that came with the upgrade, but I think I got them all ironed out. However if you find any new bugs, let me know. You can email bypassgamestudios@gmail.com or make a post on the user forums about it.

In addition, I have a few minor improvements. Here's the patch notes.

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Upgraded to Unity 2019, a much needed upgrade. There aren't many noticeable changes, but there are many back end changes that were needed.
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added some improvements to the campaign UI.
[*]When a chapter is completed, you now have the option to continue to the next chapter or go back to the main menu (previously you were forced back to the menu).
[*]Added chapter titles to the beginning and end of each chapter.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the AI players would not aggro at the appropriate distance when using the crossbow.
[*]Fixed a bug where the shop menu would sometimes cover up items in certain resolutions.
[/list]

As always, have fun and keep your eyes peeled for the next update!

notes.title: Update: Gun Mans, Part 2
notes.content:
April 3, 2019 Sword Mans version 1.3.1

Well Gun Mans has been fun, but April Fools is over and I think it's time we put the swords back in Sword Mans. But if you ever have the urge to play Gun Mans again, it'll be an option in the versus menu from now on. When starting a versus game, select options and turn on "Play Gun Mans" to turn all the swords back into guns.

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Put the swords back.
[*]Added the option to play Gun Mans in versus mode whenever you want. The pistol, revolver, uzi, shotgun, crossbow, sniper rifle, tommy gun, LMG, grenade launcher, and rocket launcher are all still available when this option is enabled.
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reordered the menus so you customize your sword mans just before starting the game. This seems more intuitive overall and allows you to choose if you're playing Gun Mans or Sword Mans before you select equipment.
[/list]

I hope you have fun with this new mode!

notes.title: Update: Gun Mans!
notes.content:
April 2, 2019 Sword Mans version 1.3.0

Happy April Fools! You thought the update was coming yesterday but you were fooled! Haha, yeah that's it (please don't read into it any further). Anyways, Sword Mans has taken a giant leap into the future. Your familiar sword wielding mans will now be wielding guns! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32239218/a3f78bb6e7bc67c23971875068c986da996ee587.png[/img]

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]All swords have been replaced with guns.
[list]
[*]Pistol: A very quick semiautomatic weapon.
[*]Revolver: A much higher damage, but slower gun.
[*]Uzi: Very fast fire rate and fully automatic.
[*]Shotgun: Slow fire rate, but shoots out multiple projectiles.
[*]Crossbow: So what if it's not a gun?
[*]Sniper Rifle: Long range with laser sights for improved accuracy. 
[*]Tommy Gun: Automatic rifle with a drum magazine.
[*]LMG: A heavy automatic weapon with a laser sight.
[*]Grenade Launcher: Fires an grenade that explodes on impact.
[*]Rocket Launcher: Launches a rocket that travels in a straight line.
[/list]
[*]New Cosmetics!
[list]
[*]Army Helmet: To protect your head from those nasty bullets. This will be available any time you start Sword Mans.
[*]Bulletproof Vest: To do the same for your torso. Also available for everyone.
[*]Battle Banner: A waving flag to show your patriotism.
[*]Ammo Belt: Slung over your shoulder for convenience.
[*]Radio: To keep in contact with your companions on the front lines.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*]Explosions now deal damage based on how close you are to the center of the explosion. With explosive weapons in the game, it made sense to reward a more accurate shot. A direct hit will deal devastating damage while a glancing blow will be more survivable.
[/list]

It's hard to believe that Sword Mans has been out for a whole year. I hope you all have had as much fun playing it as I've had making and continually improving it. Be sure to use the steam community hub if you have any questions or suggestions about Sword Mans. 

Thank you all and have fun!

notes.title: Update: Sword Mans Anniversary!
notes.content:
Happy Birthday Sword Mans!

A year ago today, Sword Mans was released on Steam! It's my first released game and I've had a lot of fun rolling out updates and I'd like to thank anyone that took the time to play it. 

I just have a little update today, so here it is:

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New hat: Birthday hat. You'll get this hat automatically if you launch Sword Mans before April 6th.
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the explosion effect that is in some levels. It should look and sound much more realistic.
[/list]

That's all for today, but keep your eyes peeled for a much much bigger update coming Monday, April 1st. As always, the update will be completely free and this one will add a lot more content. I've been working on this update for a long time now and it's nearly ready to drop. Have fun and wish Sword Mans a happy birthday!

notes.title: Update: Lives and Time Limits
notes.content:
July 20, 2018: Sword Mans version 1.1.2

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added versus mode specific settings to a options versus mode options menu. The “number of rounds” and “random stage select” options can now be found in this new menu.
[*]Added lives per round option to the versus options menu.
[*]Added time per round option to the versus options menu.
[/list]

This update will help bring a lot more customization to the versus gameplay. I experimented with having a few different game versus modes. The modes were rounds (what we had before), lives, and time. But then I figured it would be nice to have a time limit on a lives game, or play multiple rounds of lives games. So instead of separate modes, all three options are now present for you to mix and match as you see fit. 

If you want to add lives or a time limit to versus mode, click the "Options" button on the stage select screen.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the AI in versus wouldn’t show its health on the healthbar.
[*]Occasionally after exploding, players would suddenly switch from controller to keyboard controls. They don’t do that anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Optimization
notes.content:
April 20, 2018: Sword Mans version 1.0.2

- Drastically improved performance on the customization screen.

- The AI is now less likely to kill itself on maps with edges such as Bridge, Tower, and Highlands.

- Fixed a bug where AI’s would sometimes boost without using their boost meter.

Developer Notes:

I had noticed that the customization menu seemed to lag a lot, especially when multiple players were editing at the same time. This patch should improve that significantly. Also AIs weren't very good at identifying the danger of falling off cliffs, so they're better at that now.
